verdict.rationale: First-party docs say prompts are managed centrally in Langfuse instead of hardcoded, are updated directly in the UI, and the application automatically fetches the latest version. Version control and labels manage deployments across environments, so prompt changes reach production without a code deploy, and SDK client-side caching means fetching adds no latency. One community user called Langfuse's prompt management 'behind in terms of features', which is general skepticism rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the label-based deploy flow, and detailed evidence on rollback and label-promotion mechanics (protected labels are Enterprise-only when self-hosted).
